algorithm: Rotate upper-half-plane H1 to K at w=-i*z with Re(w)>=0; use conjugation for recessive H2.
Reduce K order to mu in [-0.5,0.5], evaluate Temme small-argument series or Thompson/Barnett CF2, then stable upward K recurrence.
Stable log-Gamma even/odd series avoids integer and near-integer order cancellation.

loop_bounds.temme: 80 terms (initial term plus k=1..79), restricted to |w|<=2.5. Coefficient recurrence contains (w*w/4)/k and the special-function recurrence supplies another inverse-k decay; this avoids using the power series where cancellation is large. These are computational truncation bounds, not relaxed predicate tolerances.
loop_bounds.cf2: 400 total steps (initial k=1 and k=2..400). Freeze all carried values once |Q*delta| < binary64_epsilon*|S|. Evaluated only for |w|>2.5 in the right half-plane, including its imaginary boundary. The fixed cap bounds work; no universal convergence guarantee beyond sampled controls is claimed.
loop_bounds.gamma: 60 log-Gamma series terms for |mu|<=1/2; evaluate even and divided odd sums directly, avoiding subtraction of nearly equal gamma values.
